digest.component_or_area: completion banking oracle and observer test seam
propositions: The 0707 dense-banking eval's observer counts only source=='tool' writes but the policy's fallback insufficiency snapshots (source='fallback') are also durable banking events that must be counted for system-level boundedness.

Post-commit e1352535ace the COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE pressure was removed, causing the model's genuine banks to arrive late (responses [6,7,8,9,9]) and fail the 3-response evidence-interval bound when fallback sources are not counted.

The observer's make_observed_upsert must re-scope from actor-filtered (source=='tool') to actor-agnostic (any durable write except seeded=True cache seeds) to align the eval's contract with system-level boundedness.
Live run 32575679530 proved the policy's per-criterion 3-response fallbacks fire on schedule (snapshots [2,5,8]), confirming system safety while the eval fails on model etiquette alone.
